Team / BrightPay procurement,

Quick note ahead of today's 10:00 PT sync — I need a fast, clean submission for our Nov commit window. Please do the following before the call: 

1) Update the commit_matrix.xlsx (tab: CURRENT_COMMIT) with: stage, expected close date, ARR delta, and a short 1-line justification.
2) Upload 1 supporting item per account to the Drive folder (link below) and mark it in evidence_manifest.csv. Acceptable items: signed LOI, PO, technical attestation, or procurement email thread.
3) For deals moving to Commit, include a one-line confidence signal: HIGH / MED / LOW. We'll reconcile any LOWs in the call.

Call (10:00 PT, 15m):
- 10:00 — Roll call & last-minute stage flips (each owner 60s)
- 10:05 — Rapid evidence check for Commit candidates (we'll spot-check 3)
- 10:09 — Flag escapes (risk, procurement blockers) + action owner
- 10:12 — Final numbers and who will push turn-in

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode: redwood)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBrightPayEvidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4721

Attachments (stubs): evidence_manifest.csv, commit_matrix.xlsx, BrightPay_one-pager.pdf

Thanks — try to have updates in 30m so I can triage before the call.
